newsitem.title: USA: Power surge hits New York, Wall Street unaffected.
newsitem.headline: Power surge hits New York, Wall Street unaffected.

text.p: An electric power surge caused lights to flicker and computer screens to blink in New York office buildings Wednesday morning.
Despite the surge, the New York and American stock exchanges both opened on time at 0930 EST/1430 GMT.
"It occurred before trading and there was no disruption or anything," said a spokesman for the American Stock Exchange.
Some major securities firms said there were no serious problems.
"We took a power hit at 9:00 am but otherwise everything is fine," a spokeswoman at Merrill Lynch & Co Inc said.
"It had no impact," a trader at Goldman, Sachs & Co said.
